<\STATESEP>chapter "Arch-specific Interrupts"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory ArchInterrupt_A
imports Ipc_A
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context Arch begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>global_naming ARM_A<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition handle_reserved_irq :: "irq \<Rightarrow> (unit,'z::state_ext) s_monad"
  where "handle_reserved_irq irq = return ()"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>fun arch_invoke_irq_handler :: "irq_handler_invocation \<Rightarrow> (unit,'z::state_ext) s_monad"
  where
  "arch_invoke_irq_handler (ACKIrq irq) = (do_machine_op $ maskInterrupt False irq)"
| "arch_invoke_irq_handler _ = return ()"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition arch_mask_irq_signal :: "irq \<Rightarrow> (unit,'z::state_ext) s_monad"
  where
  "arch_mask_irq_signal irq \<equiv> do_machine_op $ maskInterrupt True irq"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
